name: memostem
description: Your reviewed knowledge, across AI conversations.

interface.longDescription: Your reviewed knowledge, across AI conversations. Save selected general knowledge as private pending drafts after consent, review it in MemoStem, and retrieve your confirmed knowledge from another connected AI.
capabilities: Private pending atomic memo and question-and-answer drafts
defaultPrompt: Use my active MemoStem knowledge about this topic and report what you found.
Check my MemoStem connection, then save the general knowledge I selected as an atomic memo draft.
Notice one teachable idea, name it, and ask before creating a private pending draft.
